metas.name: Resident Evil
metas.description: Zach Cregger's new take on the survival-horror franchise: a hapless courier is trapped in a hospital outbreak. Expect sharp, fast-moving horror with an ordinary guy in way over his head.

metas.name: Talk to Me
metas.description: Teens turn a séance hand into a party game and get hooked on possession. It's peer pressure and grief made literal, with nasty stakes that keep climbing.

metas.name: Thoroughbreds
metas.description: Two estranged rich-kid friends in Connecticut casually talk themselves into murdering a stepfather. A deadpan, chilly dark comedy about people calmly going along with something monstrous.

metas.name: Our Hero, Balthazar
metas.description: A rich New York teen trying to impress his activist crush follows an online contact to Texas, thinking he can stop a mass act of violence. It's a dark comedy thriller about internet-age self-delusion that keeps getting more uncomfortable.

metas.name: Ready or Not
metas.description: A new bride's wedding night turns into a deadly game of hide-and-seek with her rich in-laws. It's a pitch-black comedy thriller about a polite family that goes along with something monstrous, and it is funny and tense all the way through.

metas.name: Marty Supreme
metas.description: A hustler chasing table-tennis glory careens from one bad decision to the next. The anxiety never lets up, it's often very funny, and there's always something at stake.

metas.name: Clayface
metas.description: A rising Hollywood star loses his face and his identity to a scientific experiment and turns into a monster bent on revenge. Body horror and a revenge story in one, with an unsparing look at vanity and fame.

metas.name: Hard Candy
metas.description: A teenage girl turns the tables on a man she meets online, and it becomes a tense two-hander of revenge and control. A lesser-known, sharply made shocker from a woman's point of view, with a merciless last act.

metas.name: Animals
metas.description: A mayoral candidate and his wife go to extreme lengths to pay their son's ransom, and secrets they never meant to reveal come out. A dark crime thriller about ordinary people doing monstrous things under pressure.

metas.name: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
metas.description: A surgeon's family is slowly torn apart by a strange teenage boy who demands an impossible sacrifice. Cold, controlled, director-driven dread with real cruelty and an ending you won't forget.
